User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the PrimeCuts Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

groupIds.description: An array of Group IDs this user belongs to.

roles.description: An array of role strings that this user has.

accountStatus.description: The status of the user's account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

accountsReceivable.description: Total amount owed by the customer.

availableCredit.description: The amount of credit available to the customer.

creditLimit.description: The total credit limit for the customer.

currency.description: The currency for the customer's transactions.

billingAddress.description: The billing address for the customer.

deliveryAddress.description: The delivery address for the customer.

telephone.description: The telephone number for the customer.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a user group with a set of roles/permissions.

name.description: The name of the group (e.g., Administrators, Sales Staff).

roles.description: An array of role strings that this group grants.

LocalizedString.title: LocalizedString
LocalizedString.description: A string that can be localized into multiple languages.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product (cut of meat) available for sale.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product entity.

images.description: URLs of the product images stored in file storage.

category.description: Category of the product (e.g., Beef, Lamb).

cutTypeId.description: Reference to the CutType this product belongs to.

price.description: The selling price of the product per base unit (e.g., per pound).

perKgPrice.description: The selling price of the product per kilogram.

styles.description: Available preparation styles for the meat.

rubs.description: Available seasoning rubs for the meat.

featured.description: Indicates whether the product is featured on the homepage.

deal.description: Indicates whether the product is part of a special deal.

bestseller.description: Indicates if the product is a bestseller.

discount.description: The discount percentage for the product.

gradeQuality.description: The grade or quality of the meat.

countryOfOrigin.description: The country where the meat originated from.

temperature.description: The temperature state of the product (e.g., Fresh, Frozen).

points.description: The point value of the product for the box builder.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was last updated.

InventoryLot.title: InventoryLot
InventoryLot.description: Represents a specific batch or lot of inventory for a product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inventory lot.

productId.description: Reference to the Product this lot belongs to.

vendorId.description: Reference to the Vendor for this lot.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for this lot (e.g., '12oz', 'Full Carcass').

quantity.description: The number of units available in this lot.

purchasePrice.description: The cost price per unit for this lot.

shipmentId.description: Identifier for the shipment this lot arrived in.

purchaseDate.description: The date this lot was purchased.

shipmentDate.description: The date this lot was received.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order entity.

paymentStatus.description: Status of the payment (e.g., pending, paid, failed, unpaid).

fulfillmentStatus.description: Status of the order fulfillment (e.g., processing, shipped, delivered).

stripePaymentIntentId.description: Stripe Payment Intent ID associated with the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the order was placed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the order was last updated.

qtyToDeliver.description: The total quantity of items to be delivered for this order.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents an item within an order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order item entity.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product in the order item.

price.description: Price of the product at the time of the order.

selectedWeight.description: Selected weight option for the product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the address entity.

fullName.description: Full name of the address recipient.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether this is the user's default address.

description.description: A short description of the primal cut.

CutType.title: CutType
CutType.description: Represents a type of meat cut.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the cut type page.

categoryId.description: The ID of the category this cut type belongs to.

imageUrl.description: URL of an image representing the cut type.

Grade.title: Grade
Grade.description: Represents a quality grade of meat.

name.description: Name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar).

isDefault.description: Indicates if this is the default currency for the store.

conversionRate.description: The conversion rate against the default currency.

MeasurementUnit.title: MeasurementUnit
MeasurementUnit.description: Represents a unit of measurement for weight.

Style.title: Style
Style.description: Represents a preparation style for meat.

name.description: Name of the style (e.g., Lean Edges).

Rub.title: Rub
Rub.description: Represents a seasoning rub for meat.

name.description: Name of the rub (e.g., Coffee Rub).

contactPerson.description: Name of the primary contact person for the vendor.

country.description: The country where the vendor is located.

DeliveryChallan.title: DeliveryChallan
DeliveryChallan.description: Represents a delivery challan for an order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the delivery challan.

dispatchedBy.description: Name of the person who dispatched the order.

description.description: Notes or description for the delivery.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents an invoice for an order.

dueDate.description: Date the invoice payment is due.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment received from a customer.

payeeName.description: Name of the person who paid, for cash transactions.

bankName.description: Name of the bank for cheque payments.

CreditNote.title: CreditNote
CreditNote.description: Represents a credit note issued to a customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the credit note.

reason.description: Reason for issuing the credit note.

issueDate.description: Date the credit note was issued.

DebitNote.title: DebitNote
DebitNote.description: Represents a debit note issued to a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the debit note.

reason.description: Reason for issuing the debit note.

issueDate.description: Date the debit note was issued.

CategoryBanner.title: CategoryBanner
CategoryBanner.description: Represents a promotional banner for a product category on the homepage.

title.description: The main text displayed on the banner (e.g., 'Beef').

imageUrl.description: URL of the uploaded banner image.

link.description: The URL the banner links to (e.g., '/products?category=Beef').

order.description: The display order of the banner.

countryOfOrigin.description: The country of origin to filter by.

HeroSettings.title: HeroSettings
HeroSettings.description: Settings for the homepage hero section.

imageUrl.description: Path to the hero background image.

PromiseSettings.title: PromiseSettings
PromiseSettings.description: Settings for the 'Our Promise' section on the homepage.

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: Represents the temperature state of a product.

name.description: Name of the temperature state (e.g., Fresh, Frozen).

BoxOption.title: BoxOption
BoxOption.description: Represents a subscription box option for the Get Started page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the box option.

name.description: Name of the box (e.g., Regular Box).

people.description: How many people the box is ideal for.

weight.description: The approximate weight of meat in the box.

price.description: The price per meal for this box.

imageId.description: The ID of the image from the placeholder library.

description.description: A short description of the box option.

order.description: The display order of the box.

points.description: The total point value for this box.

SocialPost.title: SocialPost
SocialPost.description: Represents an AI-generated social media post.

productId.description: Reference to the Product this post is about.

productName.description: The name of the product at the time of generation.

postText.description: The generated text content for the social media post.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the main product image used.

platform.description: The social media platform the post was generated for.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the post was generated.

ChooseBoxStep.title: ChooseBoxStep
ChooseBoxStep.description: Represents a step in the 'From block to box to you' section on the homepage.

order.description: The display order of the step.

name.description: The English title of the step, for internal reference.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the PrimeCuts Hub e-commerce application, focusing on secure user authentication, product catalog management, order processing, and role-based access control (RBAC). The structure prioritizes authorization independence to ensure scalable and maintainable security rules. Private user data is stored in hierarchical paths under `/users/{userId}`, and collaborative data patterns, like membership maps, are employed where appropriate.

Authorization Independence is achieved through denormalization. For instance, the `userId` field in the `/orders` and `/addresses` collections duplicates data, but this allows security rules to validate ownership without complex `get()` calls.  User roles are also stored directly on the User document.

QAPs (Rules are not Filters) are supported through structural segregation and path-based ownership. For example, user profiles are stored under `/users/{userId}`, ensuring that listing users does not expose private data to unauthorized users.  Products are in a top-level `/products` collection. Order data is similarly segregated under `/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}` to ensure that only the user or an admin can access order details.
